task.ques: Locate a recipe for an American apple pie on Allrecipes with a rating of at least 4 stars and more than 50 reviews. Note the maximum temperature mentioned in the Directions.

claude.final_answer: FINAL: American Apple Pie on Allrecipes qualifies: 4.4/5 stars and 52 reviews (77 ratings). The maximum temperature mentioned in the Directions is 425°F (220°C), in the instruction to preheat the oven. Source: https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/12092/american-apple-pie/ (accessed October 27, 2026). Screenshot: final.png.
